title: Stable Softmax
signature: def softmax(x: np.ndarray, axis: int = -1) -> np.ndarray
hints: softmax(x) equals softmax(x - c) for any constant c along the axis.
Pick c so that the largest exponent is exp(0) = 1. Then nothing overflows.
Use keepdims=True so the max and the sum broadcast back against x.
